units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sanhedrin 9:7:1">Y. Snh. IX, end, 27ᵇ</cite> (expl. <he>המקלל בקסם</he>) <he>כגון … לקַנְיָיךְ קַיְינָךְ קַנְוָוךְ</he> like those Nabatæans who curse, ‘(a curse) on thy owner (Maker), thy possession, on him who gave thee possession’; (Bab.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 81b">ib. 81ᵇ</cite> in Hebr. dict.: <he>לו ולקונו ולמקנו</he>).
